title: LIBERO simulation assets (HF jadechoghari/libero-assets) as actually loaded by the timan107 workers during the Rev 1 libero_spatial primary run

integrity.rollup_method: find . -type f | LC_ALL=C sort | xargs sha256sum | sha256sum

content.license: undeclared (HF cardData.license=null as of 2026-08-29; no LICENSE file in the snapshot)

provenance.measured_by: Execution Authority (dispatch_surface Rev 1 archive, Rev 2 Phase 0 0c)

caveats: libero_10 primary never touched this directory: KITCHEN/LIVING_ROOM scenes do not load scenes/libero_tabletop_base_style.xml.
License is undeclared on the HF repo card; this is a provenance limitation of the libero_spatial results until the upstream declares one.

The directory was populated by 48 workers cold-starting concurrently; the 48 first-episode FileNotFoundError retries in the spatial journal (attempt=2) are this download race, all absorbed by the conductor.
integrity.sentinel_files lists only the file whose absence caused the retries (size not recorded); it is NOT a census. The rollup sha256 covers all 1758 files.
